mapper.sql: id, wait_member_id, run_id, group_id, operation_id, task_id, request_fingerprint, cancel_request_id, state, next_attempt_at, attempt_count, claimed_by, claim_token, lease_until, last_error, terminal_task_id, terminal_status, terminal_confirmed_at
mapper.select: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member_stop s SET state = 'CLAIMED', claimed_by = #{owner}, claim_token = #{claimToken}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE s.id = ( SELECT candidate.id FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member_stop candidate JOIN alphafrog_agent_run r ON r.id = candidate.run_id WHERE r.deployment_id = #{deploymentId} AND r.deployment_generation_id = #{deploymentGenerationId} AND ((candidate.state = 'PENDING' AND candidate.next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (candidate.state = 'CLAIMED' AND candidate.lease_until <= #{now})) ORDER BY candidate.next_attempt_at, candidate.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF candidate SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING s.id
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member_stop SET state = 'PENDING', claimed_by = NULL, claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{stopId} AND state = 'CLAIMED' AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member_stop SET state = 'BLOCKED_PROOF', claimed_by = NULL, claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{stopId} AND state = 'CLAIMED' AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member_stop s SET state = 'CONFIRMED', task_id = COALESCE(s.task_id, #{taskId}), terminal_task_id = #{taskId}, terminal_status = #{terminalStatus}, terminal_confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, claimed_by = NULL, claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM alphafrog_agent_run child WHERE s.id = #{stopId} AND child.id = s.run_id AND s.state = 'CLAIMED' AND s.claim_token = #{claimToken} AND s.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (s.task_id IS NULL OR s.task_id = #{taskId}) AND #{terminalStatus} IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE( child.snapshot_json #> '{data_analysis_observability,calls}', '[]'::jsonb)) AS terminal(call) WHERE terminal.call ->> 'operationId' = s.operation_id AND terminal.call ->> 'taskId' = #{taskId} AND terminal.call ->> 'terminalStatus' = #{terminalStatus} AND terminal.call #>> '{reservation,state}' = 'TERMINAL_CONFIRMED' AND NULLIF(terminal.call ->> 'terminalAt', '') IS NOT NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member_stop WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND id > #{afterStopId} AND state <> 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member_stop s WHERE s.state <> 'CONFIRMED' AND (s.run_id = #{rootRunId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i WHERE i.child_run_id = s.run_id AND i.root_run_id = #{rootRunId})) )
